title: Task-SEEG recordings from epilepsy patients performing a visual working memory task (Tian, Figshare 32189838)
description: Stereo-electroencephalography (SEEG) recordings from seven patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a visual working memory task. Depth electrodes were placed solely according to clinical needs. The dataset comprises eight continuous EDF recordings sampled at 2048 Hz, shared in BIDS iEEG format, to support investigation of the neural mechanisms of working memory in the human brain.
methods_description: Multi-contact depth electrodes (8-16 contacts, 0.8 mm diameter, 1.5 mm spacing) were stereotactically implanted with robotic assistance. Signals were recorded with a Nicolet EEG amplifier at 2048 Hz, referenced online to a white matter site chosen by the clinical team, while participants performed a visual working memory task.
